motion.name: state-easing
motion.purpose: Restrained state feedback on example selection and buttons.

components.name: Primary source action
components.description: Source-first adoption actions, not unsupported registry installation.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:3.25rem; padding:0.8rem 1.4rem; background:var(--lime); color:var(--on-lime); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius); font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--lime-hover); border-color:var(--on-lime); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Selected example tab
components.description: Explicit active-example state with keyboard selection.
components.css: .ds-tab { min-height:44px; padding:0.6rem 1rem; color:var(--on-petrol); background:var(--petrol); border:0; border-radius:var(--radius); font-weight:600; } .ds-tab:hover { background:var(--petrol-deep); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Copy control
components.description: Enhanced clipboard action with manual selection recovery.
components.css: .ds-copy { min-height:44px; padding:0.5rem 0.85rem; background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); border-radius:var(--radius); } .ds-copy:hover { background:var(--soft-field); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: Readable specifications, code specimens and evidence tables explain a native language frontend without inventing product claims.
dos: Use semantic HTML and project-prefix-safe links.
Keep fixture and benchmark provenance explicit.
donts: Do not imply browser query execution.
Do not ship development metadata as public assets.
